decisions.rationale: Leading Charizard and Venusaur allows immediate Mega Evolution into Charizard Y to set Drought, activating Venusaur's Chlorophyll speed boost. Chlorophyll Venusaur outspeeds non-Tailwind foes and cleanly OHKOs Whimsicott with 4x Sludge Bomb or Water-types with Sun-boosted Solar Beam, while Sun-boosted Heat Wave pressures Metagross and Whimsicott's Focus Sash. Dragapult and Garganacl in the back provide fast cleaning/Will-O-Wisp support and Wide Guard/Salt Cure pressure against Metagross and rain
decisions.notebook:
Game 1: Opponent brought Whimsicott (Focus Sash, Timid), Metagross (Shuca Berry, Adamant), Politoed (Sitrus Berry, Calm), Basculegion (Life Orb, Adamant). Delphox-Mega and Tsareena were benched.
Politoed: Drizzle, Weather Ball, Icy Wind, Rain Dance, Protect.
Basculegion: Life Orb, Swift Swim, Wave Crash, Last Respects, Aqua Jet, Protect.
Whimsicott: Focus Sash, Tailwind, Taunt, Encore, Moonblast.
Metagross: Shuca Berry, Meteor Mash, Stomping Tantrum, Rock Slide, Protect.
Strategy: Sun core (Charizard-Y + Chlorophyll Venusaur) overrides Rain and gains immediate turn 1 momentum. Dragapult offers fast Speed control and status, Garganacl provides Wide Guard against spread moves and Salt Cure tick damage against Steel/Water types.

decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott+Basculegion for immediate Tailwind pressure, with Politoed available to switch in after Charizard Mega Evolves and overwrite Drought. Metagross provides the strongest coverage into Tinkaton, Garganacl, and Charizard while avoiding excessive rain conflict.
decisions.notebook: Core plan: control weather with Politoed and clean with Swift Swim Basculegion; preserve Basculegion when practical. Mega Charizard Y resets sun on Mega entry, so switch Politoed in after Mega Evolution or use Rain Dance to restore rain. Against Charizard+Venusaur, Tailwind while pivoting Basculegion to Politoed can remove sun, disable Chlorophyll, and interrupt Solar Beam. Whimsicott supplies priority Tailwind, Taunt, and Encore. Revealed sets: Charizard-Mega-Y—Heat Wave, Solar Beam, Scorching Sands, Protect; Venusaur—Sludge Bomb, Solar Beam, Weather Ball, Protect, Life Orb/Chlorophyll; Goodra-Hisui—Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Flamethrower, Protect, Sitrus Berry/Sap Sipper; Dragapult—Phantom Force, Dragon Darts, U-turn, Will-O-Wisp, Spell Tag/Infiltrator. Respect Garganacl Wide Guard and Tinkaton Fake Out/Feint. In rain, Politoed Weather Ball strongly threatens Mega Charizard Y. With two allies fainted, boosted Last Respects is preferred for Dragapult.

decisions.rationale: Charizard Mega Evolves to set Sun via Drought and uses Protect to safely scout and neutralize potential fast Wave Crash under Tailwind. Venusaur's Chlorophyll doubles its Speed in Sun, allowing it to hit Whimsicott with Sludge Bomb to break its Focus Sash down to 1 HP before Whimsicott can make further plays. This sets up a clean double-KO pressure turn on Turn 2 with spread Heat Wave and Solar Beam.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur at 256 Speed in Sun outspeeds almost all Basculegion spreads in Tailwind (max 260, standard <240) and guarantees an OHKO with STAB Life Orb Solar Beam (102.6-187.7%). Charizard uses spread Heat Wave to clear Whimsicott's remaining 1 HP and chip Basculegion if Whimsicott doesn't Prankster Encore into Protect. Even if Whimsicott Encores Charizard, Venusaur safely removes Basculegion before it can launch a major attack.

Garganacl is the best replacement choice here because it has Protect to stall out opposing Tailwind and Rain turns while avoiding Swift Swim Basculegion's massive boosted attacks. Salt Cure also threatens massive 25%/turn damage on Water-types like Basculegion and Politoed. Dragapult lacks Protect and would be forced to take a fast hit under Tailwind + Rain before acting, so preserving Dragapult for late-game cleanup after weather/Tailwind expire maximizes win probability.

reflections.summary: Bringing the Charizard-Y and Venusaur Sun core into Politoed's Rain team allowed the opponent to easily steal weather control with Drizzle and Rain Dance, leaving Venusaur unable to sweep and leaving Garganacl vulnerable to Rain-boosted Water attacks.
reflections.adjustment: Drop the Charizard-Y and Venusaur reliance against heavy Rain modes, relying instead on Garganacl's Wide Guard and Dragapult to manage Swift Swim users while maintaining weather neutral control.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Rain Core: Politoed carries Drizzle, Rain Dance, Weather Ball, and Icy Wind to guarantee weather control. Whimsicott runs Focus Sash with Prankster Tailwind, Taunt, and Encore. Metagross holds Shuca Berry.

reflections.summary: Won because the rain composition matched the opponent’s Mega Charizard Y–Venusaur sun plan: repeated rain control suppressed sun benefits, Metagross removed Venusaur, and Politoed’s single-target rain Weather Ball bypassed Garganacl’s Wide Guard while Encore limited its stalling. The four brought were appropriate, and no Mega evolution was needed.
reflections.adjustment: If replaying, bring the same rain four but preserve Whimsicott to Taunt or Encore Garganacl earlier, rather than letting Metagross absorb repeated Salt Cure pressure; continue using single-target Weather Ball instead of spread attacks into Wide Guard.
reflections.notebook: Opponent favored Mega Charizard Y with Venusaur, Dragapult, and Garganacl over Goodra-Hisui or Tinkaton. Garganacl Protects against obvious Water targeting and leans on Salt Cure for attrition. Rain remains the preferred preview plan: preserve Politoed for weather control and Whimsicott for priority disruption; rain-boosted Weather Ball bypasses Wide Guard, deals about 74% to Garganacl, and Politoed naturally outspeeds it.
